messages:
maria.g: quick postmortem tie-up: Im building a tiny sprintboard slice for all remediation work from today. want explicit owners + ETA for the DR/regional failover follow-ups. goal: ship fixes and run a game day next week.

aj: acked. Ill own routing tests and the game day ops on 2025-06-10. will prepare traffic-shift tooling and a rollback recipe.

leah: Ill own backups and snapshot verification. ETA: first checklist and automated verifier by 2025-06-04 EOD. adding expected run times.

samir: Ill update the restore runbook (partial and full restore steps) and add artifact integrity checks. opened a draft PR.

nate: repeating incident pattern to call out: cross-region KV-store timeouts -> cascading retries -> routing thrash. recommend circuit breaker + cache rehydrate step in the runbook.

ops-bot: Runbooks PR created: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/349 by samir (status: review_required).

maria.g: please attach rough hours to the sprint card and label tests: smoke, full-restore, routing-validate. tentative game day: 2025-06-10 16:00 UTC.

leah: checklist added to card:
```
- snapshot integrity check (sha256)
- restore to staging single-region
- restore to staging cross-region
- smoke test / health endpoints
- verify routing headers/token passthrough
```
Ill script the integrity check.

aj: sample traffic-shift helper Ill use:
```
# gradual shift example
./route-shift --from eu-west1 --to us-west1 --step 20 --wait 300
```
Ill also prepare a fast rollback mode (instant shift to previous region).

samir: logs show a ~30s latency buildup before past failovers. adding metric gate: p95 > 2s sustained 10m -> pause automated failover. will add alert and runbook step.

nate: added runbook note: if KV timeouts detected, pause routing shift and perform cache warmup:
```
- pause shift
- populate caches from replica
- resume at 10% increments
```

maria.g: owners recap: aj (routing + game day), leah (backups & verifiers), samir (runbook + alerts), nate (pattern analysis). Ill follow up with a post-game closure thread. thanks all :thumbsup:
